_comment: Settings for issue_report.py and the triage package. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored. Pass --config to use another file.

episodes._comment: An episode is a stretch of consecutive failing steps, reported as one finding.
episodes._max_pass_gap_note: Passing steps that re-checked a failing rule, allowed inside an episode before it ends. Failures that flicker stay one episode. Passing steps that did not check the failing rules (e.g. schema-panel steps while a Data-panel rule fails) are not counted here.
episodes._max_unchecked_gap_note: Steps that did not check the failing rules, allowed inside an episode before it ends anyway, so an episode cannot span a whole run just because its rule is rarely checked.
episodes._blip_max_steps_note: An unnamed episode that recovered by itself and lasted at most this many steps is a blip (listed in a table, not as a card).
episodes._repro_window_note: Number of actions up to and including the first failing step shown as the reproduction recipe.

log_markers._comment: Wording the mutation loop writes into step descriptions. Update these if the log messages change.

invariants._comment: Plain-language statement of what must always hold. Rules not listed here use the name from the log.
invariants.INV-S0: The schema held by the editor is always a valid JSON object
invariants.INV-S3: The title shown in the Schema panel matches the schema MetaConfigurator holds internally
invariants.INV-D1: The Data Text View parses to exactly the same object as the editor's internal data
invariants.INV-D3: The GUI's required-field stars match the schema's required list
invariants.INV-D4: Every GUI row has a matching data key, and no stale values are left in the GUI
invariants.INV-D5: String values shown in the GUI match the data
invariants.INV-D6: The GUI's validation icons match the schema violations in the data
invariants.INV-S1: The Schema Text View parses to exactly the same object as the editor's internal schema
invariants.INV-S2: Every top-level schema key has a visible row in the Schema GUI
invariants.INV-GUI-ERR-01: A validation error shown in the Text View is also shown by the GUI View's error indicator
invariants.INV-G2: The GUI is not stuck on a loading spinner
invariants.TEMP-RENAME-05: Committing a property name that did not exist before never opens the Rename conflict dialog

retired_invariants._comment: Episodes that fail only these invariants are filtered out.
retired_invariants.INV-D2: Retired: replaced by temporal invariant TEMP-ADD-03

known_bugs.summary: After switching from Schema mode back to Data mode without editing, the Text View shows 0 markers and 0 gutter icons while 2-3 schema violations are still in the data.
known_bugs.name: Text View markers lost after switching Schema → Data
known_bugs.comment: Repro: data that violates the schema (e.g. an extra top-level key) shows red markers; switch to Schema mode and back to Data mode without editing. Expected: same markers as before. Actual: none until the next edit; the GUI View keeps its red triangles. Runs: 20261021_175138 (Autonomous Vehicle) steps 3, 5, 10, 21; 20261020_231523 (Strenda) steps 47-48 after schema_undo then switch (unconfirmed variant). INV-D7 is in NO_REPAIR_INVARIANTS in repair.py.

known_bugs.summary: With additionalProperties: false at the top level, every extra key gets a 'must NOT have additional properties' marker except the blank key "".
known_bugs.name: Blank key skipped by additionalProperties marker
known_bugs.comment: Repro: add "" and other extra keys to the data. {"": {}, "x": 1} gives 1 marker, {"x": 1, "y": 1} gives 2, {"": {}} alone gives 0. A key in required but not in properties still gets the marker, so only the blank key is skipped. Run 20261021_175138 steps 6, 11, 13-18: INV-D7 reported 'additionalProperties predicted, NO marker'.

known_bugs.summary: Replacing an object with a string in the Text View makes the GUI show one row per character, and clicking the delete icon on one of those rows throws a TypeError.
known_bugs.name: String value at object node creates per-character GUI rows
known_bugs.comment: Repro (Strenda): add an item to Experiments, replace experiments[1] ({}) with a string such as "BPiOebcB" in the Text View, expand Item 2 in the GUI View, click the delete icon on row 0-7. Expected: like 12345 or [] - warning, keeps ': object' and its four schema rows. Actual: extra rows 0-7 typed any; deleting row 1 shows 'Unknown Error occurred' and TypeError: Cannot delete property '1' of [object String]. Run 20261020_231523 steps 3-5. Reproduced by hand on metaconfigurator.org (index-981d8f4a.js); only strings affected. The delete error is app-handled, so INV-G1 does not catch it. Confirmed open on v2.7.0 and v2.8.0 (hosted) by regression sequence tests/regression/bug10 (4 steps, reduced 2026-10-27 from replay 20261020_231523/replays/20261027_194208): rows experiments[1].0-7 at step 4.

known_bugs.summary: A 'Rename conflict' dialog opens when a property name is committed with Enter, although no field with that name existed.
known_bugs.name: Spurious 'Rename conflict' dialog after adding or renaming a property
known_bugs.comment: Repro: Schema tab, empty schema, GUI View: click 'New Subschema' under $defs (or definitions), select all, type a new name (e.g. pioneer), press Enter. The property is created, then the dialog 'Rename conflict - The data already contains a field named "pioneer" at this location. Renaming would overwrite it.' opens. Also happens when renaming an existing property to a new name, and when $defs already exists. Cause: PropertyMetadata.vue commits the name on Enter (@keydown.enter) and again on blur (@blur); the blur fires before the tree re-renders, so it is emitted with the old name and the new name, and shouldPromptForRenameConflict (utility/renameUtils.ts) finds the key the first commit created. Run 20261025_044641 steps 17-18 (raven, nimbus). The loop clicks 'Proceed but keep existing data' (gui_actions._dismiss_rename_conflict).

not_a_bug.summary: Undo leaves an orphaned row across Text View and GUI View
not_a_bug.note: After renaming a required key, the old key stays in the data as an optional row and the new key is required. INV-D4 now ignores rows for keys the schema declares.

caveats.undo_redo_across_panels: This sequence uses Undo/Redo and touches both panels. Undo stacks are per panel (Data and Schema), so first check that the Undo was pressed in the same panel as the edit; otherwise the failure may not be an app bug.

screenshots._comment: Screenshots are named step_<N>_<action>.png. N counts the main actions; the tool's own undo/retry screenshots share the N of the action that triggered them. Files are matched by N and action name. They are looked up in the run's folder (tests/output/runs/<run_id>/screenshots) and, for runs recorded before the runs/ layout, in <root>/<run_id>.
screenshots._max_width_px_note: With Pillow installed, images are shrunk to this width and saved as JPEG. 0 embeds the originals.

state_snapshots._comment: Full before/after app state for a step where an invariant failed. Written by mutation_loop's export_history() for every failing step of a live run (tests/output/runs/<run_id>/states) and by replay_runner for a replay (tests/output/runs/<run_id>/replays/<replay_id>/states). A card shows the diff when the states folder next to the history is found. Runs recorded before the runs/ layout are looked up in <root>/<run_id>. Otherwise it suggests: python -m tests.mutation_testing.replay.replay_runner --history <history.json>
state_snapshots._root_note: Files are <root>/<run_id>/step_<N>_before.json and step_<N>_after.json, where N is the 0-based position in the history's 'steps' list.

project._comment: Used in the drafted GitHub issue text and the 'Start here' box.

invariant_details._comment: Optional 'look_for': what is visible on screen when the rule is broken. Rules without an entry get a generic sentence.

INV-D1.look_for: The Data Text View shows different content than the GUI View shows for the same data.

INV-S1.look_for: The Schema Text View shows different content than the Schema GUI shows for the same schema.

INV-D3.look_for: A field's required star is missing in the GUI, or shown on a field that is not required.

INV-D5.look_for: A text field in the GUI shows a different value than the data contains.

INV-D6.look_for: A field shows a validation-error icon it should not have, or lacks one it should have.

INV-S2.look_for: A top-level schema key (such as properties or required) has no row in the Schema GUI.

INV-S3.look_for: The title field in the Schema panel and the "title" in the schema's Text View show different values.

INV-D4.look_for: The GUI shows a row with content that has no matching key in the data (an orphaned row), or a data key has no row.

INV-G2.look_for: A loading spinner stays on in the GUI View and never goes away; the GUI does not respond.

INV-GUI-ERR-01.look_for: The Text View marks a validation error, but the GUI View shows no error icon for that field.

time_filter._comment: How run start times are read for --since and --until: meta.resolved_settings.run_id, then the history file's folder name, then the file's modified time.

defaults._comment: Used when no folder is given.

log_excerpt._comment: Rows shown around the first failing action.

episode_sequence._comment: Maximum rows in 'What happened during this failure'.

causal._comment: Settings for causal_analysis.py (the 'Where it likely started' section).
causal._transition_rule_prefixes_note: Rules whose id starts with one of these compare the state before and after a single action, so the failing action itself is the lead. Add NEW- here if NEW-xx rules behave the same way.

rule_reads._comment: Which state facets each rule reads, so the report only suspects actions that changed one of them. Facets: de_data, de_schema, se_schema, se_data, de_text, se_text. For rules not listed, any state change makes an action a suspect.

issue_report._comment: Settings for issue_report.py (the short list of distinct problems).
issue_report._inferred_rule_prefixes_note: Rules mined automatically from recorded runs. A problem found only by such rules is tagged 'inferred rule' and sorted last, because the rule itself may be wrong.
issue_report._blank_gui_prefix_note: An INV-D4 message starting with this text means no data key has a GUI row (blank GUI). Must match _BLANK_PREFIX in gui_rows_match_data_keys.py.
issue_report._blank_gui_implies_note: Rules dropped from a problem when it is a blank GUI: with no rows there are no stars or icons, so these failures are fallout, not separate problems.

short_names.INV-D1: Data Text View differs from the internal data
short_names.INV-D3: Required-field stars in the GUI are wrong
short_names.INV-D4: GUI rows do not match the data (orphaned or missing row)
short_names.INV-D4:blank: The GUI is blank (no data key has a row)
short_names.INV-D5: String values in the GUI differ from the data
short_names.INV-D6: Validation icons in the GUI are wrong
short_names.INV-S0: The schema is no longer a valid object
short_names.INV-S1: Schema Text View differs from the internal schema
short_names.INV-S2: A top-level schema key has no GUI row
short_names.INV-S3: Schema title field differs from the internal schema
short_names.INV-GUI-ERR-01: Text View shows a validation error the GUI does not
short_names.INV-G2: The GUI is stuck on a loading spinner (frozen)
short_names.TEMP-ADD-03: Adding a required item does not reach the data
short_names.TEMP-RENAME-05: A Rename conflict dialog opens for a name that did not exist before

run_logs._comment: The mutation loop's own log: tests/output/runs/<run_id>/mutation_log.html, found next to the history. The root below is only the older layout (mutation_logs/<run_id>/mutation_log.html, plural).
